verdicts.rationale: Reviewed (reviewer + challenger, HIGH): FCA 30398R is Thrive Homes Limited with status "Registered - Transferred Engagements": its details page records a full transfer to 30183R Watford Community Housing Trust, which is what replaced it. Both orgs are Thrive Homes, and witness 030586-2025 (June 2025) publishes "Thrive Homes Limited" with GB-MPR-30398R and this PPON on one party, so the pair is the same body. Routing anything to the successor 30183R is a separate question.
